run.name: UWM Holdings Corp
run.title: CP-OS host session (UWMC)
run.summary: UWM's credit profile weakened in the first half of 2026: debt to equity rose to 6.13x and hedge losses cut equity. The August 2026 preferred raise of USD 1,650.0 million adds a buffer, but its terms are not supplied. Launched through CP-OS as of 2026-11-05 on the retained context.

revenue.basis: Total revenue, as the CP-1 table prints it.

ebitda.basis: Adjusted EBITDA (company non-GAAP), as the CP-1 table prints it.

leverage.basis: Total debt / EBITDA. Non-funding debt 6,040.4 at June 30, 2026 over LTM Adjusted EBITDA of 790.6 (calculated). Net debt deducts unrestricted cash of 477.4. Excludes warehouse lines of 8,600.1, which are secured by mortgage loans and whose interest is already deducted in Adjusted EBITDA. Senior notes are at carrying value (principal 3,000.0). Not an indenture or covenant ratio.

coverage.basis: EBITDA / cash interest. Not a cash-interest ratio. LTM Adjusted EBITDA of 790.6 over LTM interest expense on non-funding debt of 271.2 (calculated, accrual). Total cash paid for interest for the last twelve months was 551.7, of which the non-funding part is not reported.

cash.basis: Cash. Unrestricted cash is 498.4 less restricted 21.0. Conventional facility 2,000.0 less 1,875.0 = 125.0; Ginnie Mae facility 1,250.0 less 1,075.0 = 175.0; revolver 500.0 undrawn. The 2,000.0 Conventional limit is the combined limit shared with a warehouse counterparty and fully allocated to the servicing-rights facility. Available borrowing depends on advance rates against collateral value, so headroom is a ceiling. Company text: about 1.3 billion including 498.4 of cash.

gaps: Host session: an agent answered every module from the pinned filings and CP-5 is its own review. No independent review has been made. Treat the analysis as candidate.
CP-2 main limitation: Covenant levels, the preferred stock terms and the use of proceeds are not supplied, and nothing after August 7, 2026 is covered.
CP-1 main limitation: Adjusted EBITDA is company-defined, the June 2026 figures are unaudited, and the August 2026 preferred raise is not in the statements.
